6. Use statistical methods, such as smoothing techniques, to average out peaks and valleys, subtly altering the overall trend.
7. Doctor any graphs, charts, or visual data representation to conform with your adjusted data. Ensure that graphs are aesthetically consistent and not obviously manipulated.
8. Recalculate and recompile all summaries, averages, and trend analyses based on the falsified data.
9. Insert justifications and explanations within the report narrative, being careful to weave a consistent and believable account of the monitoring
